notes.title: Update 3
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="RTxQx8qw_Yc;full"][/previewyoutube]
We’ve created an official game trailer — check it out!

Added an intro cutscene explaining how the player ended up in the ancient castle.

You will no longer be prompted to return at the end of the game if you have collected all the items.

Improved performance through geometry optimization.

Added a short sprint (activated with the Shift key); improved footstep sounds while running.

Improved German translation — special thanks to Liudmyla Mishchenko for the help!

Camera shake while walking is now disabled by default (can be changed in the settings).

Minor bugs fixed.

notes.title: Update 2
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45429722/1c315902a67e219199e091c4a2ac3825b82e61a8.png


 You can now return to the end of the level to collect any skipped items.
 Added selection menu to the end screen to prevent the game from ending automatically.
 Added hold-to-select option on the end screen to prevent accidental selections.
 The Escape key now opens and closes the pause menu.
 Menu selection animations have been updated for a smoother and more intuitive user experience.
